title: ExtractionRecord
description: The pursuit workspace's extraction artifact (extraction.json; C9/C10, P32b / P1-8 narrow): per intake document, which stack read it and its fingerprint, whether the read degraded, the flags the seam raised, and the code-forced mandatory_review (no payload shape can unset it); plus the two-path cell diff per document where the deterministic and VLM paths were both read. Written inside the intake checkpoint guard, so it is byte-stable across resume and rebuilt only by re-running intake. A file that fails this schema is skipped by the metric reader exactly as an unparseable one is (M-23) and named on the board (B145 §3d).

extractor.description: The stack that read the document — every stamp names a real stack (the C12 seam): docling, pypdf, python-docx, openpyxl, text; a fake backend stamps its own name.

extraction_fingerprint.description: The stack's version fingerprint (extraction/fingerprint.py) — resume-stable, no timing.

degraded.description: The stack reported a partial read.

flags.description: The seam's flag vocabulary — code-owned and finite (intake/extract.py, intake/brief.py); a new flag is a schema change by design.

mandatory_review.description: Code-forced from degraded OR any flag (the planning-gate idiom).

two_path.description: filename -> the cell-level review of that document's tables against the VLM path (spec §A2.3); only documents the two-path tripwire read appear (P1-33: keyed by FILENAME).

error.description: Present when the VLM path failed: the review is empty and the document carries two_path_unavailable.
